description: A horizontal resource timeline on the Svelte 5 data grid: teams are rows, time runs left to right on a scrollable axis and work items are bars sized to their real durations, from half-day blocks to multi-day tasks. Switch timelineDay with hour ticks or timelineWeek with day ticks, drag a bar to re-time it, drop it on another team's row to reassign or drag an edge to resize. rangeSelectable lets you click or drag empty space to mark a range and press Enter to create, and eventSelectable lets you Ctrl-click bars to multi-select and Delete to remove; bar fill is the team and the left strip is the status.

faq.question: How do I get a timeline instead of a calendar?
faq.answer: Include timelineDay or timelineWeek in views with resourceField and resources set. Each resource becomes a row and events lay out as horizontal bars.

faq.question: How is a bar reassigned to another team?
faq.answer: Drop it on the other row. onEventMove receives the new resource id along with the times, and the demo writes it to the row's team field.

faq.question: How does keyboard range selection work?
faq.answer: With rangeSelectable, click an empty slot to mark it, arrow keys move the range, Shift with arrows extends it and Enter opens the add flow through onRangeSelect.
